title: HELIOS absorption watch list (config/absorption/pr-watchlist.json)
description: Curated upstream PRs benchmarked for absorption. Bound by src/mcp/HELIOS.Mcp/HeliosStatusTools.cs and src/ai/HELIOS.AIHub.Cli/AbsorptionStatus.cs (pr / title / status / epic), read by scripts/absorption/absorb-pr.ps1 and scripts/fleet/seed-absorption-tasks.ps1 (status / epic filters). status moves candidate -> benchmarked -> absorbed | rejected and is flipped by humans after reading the report; nothing here merges automatically. The remaining fields are the review notes the ledger (docs/architecture/ABSORPTION_LEDGER.md) carries; entries are closed so a misspelled key cannot hide a note.

upstream.description: owner/name of the repository the PR numbers refer to.

absorbedInto.description: Where an absorbed candidate landed (tranche, workflow, script).

reason.description: Free-form disposition note (how or why it was absorbed or rejected).
